items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I studied xylophone with my teacher... His name was Richard Shaw... he was the best teacher around

ctx.x: Some of the jazz magazines say that you started playing drums around 13 with some bands around there -- is that right?

Before studying drums, I studied xylophone with my teacher, and he was a Bower pupil, too. His name was Richard Shaw, Dick Shaw -- Howard Shaw, H-o-w-a-r-d. But we called him Dick. And he was also a Bower pupil and came to Portland to live, and he played in the pit there. Well, he was the best teacher around, and my uncle was busy with his insurance business, but used to come up once or twice a week to give me a little lesson, and have dinner
with my grandmother, and he didn't have the patience with me, so they sent me to a teacher.
